name: Hashi
source:
Hashi bounces between kitchen, storage, and every shift in between. He's complaining the entire time about how much work there is and how messy everyone else is. Maybe that's what happens when you're too reliable.

Likes: Working, Being relied on, Sleeping

Dislikes: Being interrupted, Partners who want him more active in bed, Food that makes him drowsy
